using System;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Jellyfin.Data.Entities;
using Jellyfin.Server.Models;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;

namespace Jellyfin.Server.Models
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Interface for database providers.
    /// </summary>
    public interface IDatabaseProvider
    {
        /// <summary>
        /// Gets the database context.
        /// </summary>
        /// <value>The database context.</value>
        DbContext DbContext { get; }

        /// <summary>
        /// Gets the database info.
        /// </summary>
        /// <value>The database info.</value>
        DatabaseInfo DatabaseInfo { get; }

        /// <summary>
        /// Gets the database configuration.
        /// </summary>
        /// <value>The database configuration.</value>
        DatabaseConfiguration DatabaseConfiguration { get; }

        /// <summary>
        /// Runs the shutdown task.
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="cancellationToken">The cancellation token.</param>
        /// <returns>A task.</returns>
        Task RunShutdownTask(CancellationToken cancellationToken);
    }
}

using Xunit;
using Moq;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Jellyfin.Server.Models;

namespace Jellyfin.Server.Tests
{
    public class DatabaseProviderTests
    {
        [Fact]
        public async Task RunShutdownTask_CancellationToken_Cancelled_DoesNotThrow()
        {
            // Arrange
            var databaseProviderMock = new Mock<IDatabaseProvider>();
            var cancellationTokenSource = new CancellationTokenSource();
            cancellationTokenSource.Cancel();

            // Act and Assert
            await databaseProviderMock.Object.RunShutdownTask(cancellationTokenSource.Token);
        }

        [Fact]
        public async Task RunShutdownTask_CancellationToken_NotCancelled_DoesNotThrow()
        {
            // Arrange
            var databaseProviderMock = new Mock<IDatabaseProvider>();
            var cancellationTokenSource = new CancellationTokenSource();

            // Act and Assert
            await databaseProviderMock.Object.RunShutdownTask(cancellationTokenSource.Token);
        }
    }
}

using Xunit;
using Moq;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Jellyfin.Server.Models;
using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;

namespace Jellyfin.Server.Tests
{
    public class ProgramTests
    {
        [Fact]
        public async Task GetRequiredService_IJellyfinDatabaseProvider_DoesNotThrow()
        {
            // Arrange
            var serviceProviderMock = new Mock<IServiceProvider>();
            var databaseProviderMock = new Mock<IJellyfinDatabaseProvider>();
            serviceProviderMock.Setup(p => p.GetRequiredService<IJellyfinDatabaseProvider>()).Returns(databaseProviderMock.Object);

            // Act and Assert
            var databaseProvider = serviceProviderMock.Object.GetRequiredService<IJellyfinDatabaseProvider>();
            await databaseProvider.RunShutdownTask(CancellationToken.None);
        }
    }
}
